title: Endobronchial Ultrasound-transbronchial Needle Aspiration (EBUS-TBNA) Sample Division
brief_summary: EBUS-TBNA specimen are used for lung cancer diagnosing and staging, as well for molecular analysis. The purpose of this study is to evaluate if samples from on lymph node site can be divided for diagnosis and molecular analysis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* clinical diagnosis of lung cancer
* enlarged mediastinal or hilar lymph nodes (\>10 mm)

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
study_population: Subjects suspected to have lung cancer and enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes
